channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-123196 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Authorizer before 2.4.2 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to control emailed link hosts by supplying x-authorizer-url gRPC metadata. Attackers can send this metadata to the gRPC port or a Grpc-Metadata-X-Authorizer-Url header through the REST gateway to capture reset or magic-link tokens and take over accounts.

item.title: CVE-2026-123197 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | WPPConnect Server through 2.10.76 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read decrypted sticker media through the /files static mount. Attackers can enumerate Unix timestamps in GET /files/file<timestamp>.webp requests to retrieve stickers from any session, bypassing per-session token checks.

item.title: CVE-2026-123198 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | LMFDB before commit 01829bd contains a server-side template injection vulnerability in the render_knowl function that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject Jinja expressions via request parameters. Attackers can supply crafted query-string values or 'content' data to /knowledge/render/<ID> to reach Python builtins and execute operating system commands as the web application account.

item.title: CVE-2026-123199 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | eBook-speaker 6.1.0 through 6.2.0 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in get_attributes() in src/common.c caused by an unbounded strcpy of an element's name attribute. Attackers can craft an EPUB or DAISY book with a name attribute of 511 or more characters to corrupt the stack and crash the reader when opened.

item.title: CVE-2026-123200 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | VRPN through 07.36 contains an out-of-bounds stack write vulnerability in vrpn_Endpoint::handle_sender_message() and handle_type_message() that allows unauthenticated remote peers to write outside a stack buffer via an unchecked length index. Attackers can connect, complete the version-cookie exchange, and send a SENDER_DESCRIPTION or TYPE_DESCRIPTION message with an out-of-range or negative index to crash the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-123201 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Buku (bukuserver) through 5.1.1 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to make the server request internal hosts by supplying a url parameter to /api/fetch_data or /api/network_handle. Attackers can target loopback, private, or cloud metadata IP addresses, which pass the weak is_bad_url() check and follow redirects, to discover internal services and read their page titles, descriptions, and keywords.

item.title: CVE-2026-123202 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | libnxml before 0.18.6 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in src/nxml_parser.c that allows remote attackers to write past a 1024-byte stack buffer via long XML names. Attackers can supply XML or RSS feeds with a 1022-character element, attribute, DOCTYPE or entity name ending in a multi-byte UTF-8 character to crash parsing applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-123203 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | NEURON (CoreNEURON) through 9.0.2 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory by supplying over-long tokens in a crafted model dataset. Attackers can place oversized version or mechanism-name tokens in bbcore_mech.dat, globals.dat, or files.dat loaded by nrniv-core to crash the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-123204 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Posta before v0.18.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users with edit rights to make the backend send POST requests to internal destinations by creating webhooks with arbitrary URLs. Attackers can target loopback, private-network or cloud metadata addresses and read delivery status codes and error strings to probe internal hosts and ports.

item.title: CVE-2026-123205 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | accel-ppp before 1.15.0 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the tcp, syslog and pgsql log targets that allows unauthenticated remote peers to overflow fixed heap buffers by producing log lines exceeding LOG_MAX_SIZE. Attackers within client-ip-range can send an L2TP Start-Control-Connection-Request with many string AVPs when verbose logging is enabled to corrupt heap memory and crash the daemon.

item.title: CVE-2026-123206 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | EdgeChat before 2.20.3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the GET /files/:key route that allows unauthenticated or banned users to download decrypted public-channel attachments because canAccessFile() accepts a null user id. Attackers holding an attachment object key can omit or supply an invalid token to retrieve plaintext attachments without a session or channel membership.

item.title: CVE-2026-123207 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | LibreTV before v2.21.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass checkUpstreamAllowed() by exploiting unpinned DNS resolution in fetchWithSafeRedirects(). Attackers controlling authoritative DNS can return public addresses during validation and internal addresses at connection time via /api/source/test, /api/proxy, /api/search or /api/detail to reach loopback services, private hosts or cloud metadata endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2026-123208 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | noname Electron desktop build v1.11.2 through v1.11.6.1 contains an unauthenticated local file server with wildcard CORS that allows malicious websites to read, overwrite, or delete installation files. Attackers can send cross-origin requests to /writeFile on localhost port 8089 to overwrite renderer scripts, executing JavaScript with Node.js access as the local user.

item.title: CVE-2026-123271 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | ChatCLI before v1.215.2 contains an improper validation vulnerability in the MCP OAuth login flow that uses server-supplied Protected Resource Metadata as the resource indicator without checking it matches the configured server URL. A malicious MCP server can declare another resource on the same authorization server, obtain the user's bearer token for it, and replay that token against the other resource.

item.title: CVE-2026-123272 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Mark3labs mcp-go before v1.2.1 contains an improper validation vulnerability in OAuthHandler.fetchServerMetadata that allows malicious MCP servers to obtain tokens for other resources by declaring arbitrary resources in well-known metadata. Attackers can declare a different MCP server as the RFC 8707 resource indicator, causing the authorization server to mint tokens the attacker replays against that resource.

item.title: CVE-2026-123273 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 and 6.9.13-60 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the SVG decoder because QueueAuthenticPixelCacheNexus in MagickCore/cache.c fails to validate requested region width and height. Attackers can supply a crafted SVG image that repeatedly requests a non-advancing pixel region, consuming CPU and hanging the decoding worker.

item.title: CVE-2026-61648 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.3
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.3 | SuiteCRM is an open-source, enterprise-ready Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software application. Prior to 7.15.2 and 8.10.2, a user-controllable Multi report condition passes parameter_value through unencodeMultienum() and concatenates the result into a SQL WHERE clause. Although securexss() normally entity-encodes quotes, an input prefixed with an XSS payload makes AntiXSS select a processed string instead of the encoded backup, allowing a literal quote to reach the database. A low-privileged user with AOR Reports access can read arbitrary tables through time-based or UNION-based SQL injection and can consume database connections with delay expressions. This issue is fixed in versions 7.15.2 and 8.10.2.

item.title: CVE-2026-61649 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.7
item.description: Thursday 5 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.7 | SuiteCRM is an open-source, enterprise-ready Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software application. Prior to 7.15.2 and 8.10.2, the SSRF protection added in 7.15.1 uses a substring comparison in isSelfRequest() rather than hostname equality. The affected flow begins at validate_external_host() and uses isSelfRequest(), and stripos() to carry attacker-controlled data or authorization state into the security-sensitive operation. An authenticated attacker can place the server hostname in a URL path to bypass IP validation and direct server-side requests to internal services. This issue is fixed in versions 7.15.2 and 8.10.2.

item.title: CVE-2026-61650 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1

This issue is fixed in versions 7.15.2 and 8.10.2.

item.title: CVE-2026-63111 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
